issue_request: FHIR-18358 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core clarification for the STU3 extensibility page asking that an unclear "they" in the Exchanging Extensions guidance be replaced with clearer wording.

additional_context: source/fhir.ini has an active [type-pages] mapping of extension=extensibility, confirming source/extensibility.html is current build input for the Extension/extensibility guidance. Later source edits touching the same page preserved the clarified sentence, and targeted Zulip and Confluence searches found no contrary evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/extensibility.html says that the more requirements are shared, "the less of an obstacle the extensions (and the requirements they represent) will represent," which resolves both the ambiguous pronoun and the unclear impact wording.
